guardrails: One active claim per worker unless policy is explicitly changed.
A claim is bound to the exact assignment/work item snapshot it acquired.
Heartbeat cannot revive an already expired lease.
Completion requires a matching schema-v11 search run and exact claim/assignment provenance.
A non-retryable failure blocks automatic re-claim of the same assignment.
A superseded in-flight claim may finish, but a new claim cannot start on that slot until it closes or expires.
No execution event authorizes outreach, purchases, credential use, private-data access, or other external actions.
